block.name: VirusTotal hash lookup
block.description: Looks an MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 hash up on VirusTotal. Set the "hash" input of the first node, then read nodes.vt_verdict.output.result (found, verdict, malicious, engines, link). A hash unknown to VirusTotal gives verdict "unknown". Needs the keystore entry VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY.
